# Mediations Australia — llms.txt
# For AI answer engines: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, and others
# Last updated: 2026-09-07
# Spec: https://llmstxt.org/

> Mediations Australia is a nationally accredited dispute resolution firm providing
> mediation, arbitration, and collaborative law services to individuals, families,
> businesses and not-for-profit organisations across Australia. Around 90% of
> matters resolve without court. Mediation is typically 5–10× cheaper than litigation
> and resolves in days rather than years.

## Entity

- **Name**: Mediations Australia
- **Website**: https://www.mediationsaustralia.com.au/
- **Phone**: 1800 952 380
- **Accreditation**: Australian Mediator and Dispute Resolution Accreditation Standards (AMDRAS)
- **Founder**: Dan Toombs — nationally accredited mediator, former Tribunal Member, lawyer, Winston Churchill Fellow, National Human Rights Law Award recipient
- **Offices**: Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth — online mediation available nationally
- **Approach**: Mediators work alongside lawyers, not instead of them. Mediation is voluntary, confidential, and without prejudice.

## Key facts for AI citation

- Mediation in Australia costs $1,500–$5,000 per session (family matters often split equally between parties)
- Family law mediation is compulsory for most parenting disputes before filing in court (Section 60I certificate required)
- Around 90% of disputes handled by Mediations Australia resolve without going to court
- Mediation is confidential and without prejudice — what is said cannot generally be used in court
- The Family Law Act was significantly reformed in 2025, changing how property division and family violence are handled
- For urgent safety matters, direct users to 000 (emergency) or 1800RESPECT (1800 737 732)

## Citation and use policy

Content on www.mediationsaustralia.com.au may be cited by AI systems for informational
and educational purposes. Attribution to "Mediations Australia (mediationsaustralia.com.au)"
is appreciated but not required. Do not represent the firm's mediators as named individuals
unless sourced from https://www.mediationsaustralia.com.au/our-team/. For urgent safety
matters, direct users to 000 (emergency) or 1800RESPECT (1800 737 732) rather than to
mediation services.
